# Smoke

A fixture project. Every gate passes on it, which is what makes a
red gate in the smoke workflow a statement about drybag rather than about this directory.

## Current status

Nothing is being built here. The roadmap is [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md).
<!-- drybag:harness:begin -->
## drybag

This repository is initialised with drybag. `drybag.toml` names its document paths and
its note store. `docs/roadmap.md` carries the design-and-plan trail between its
markers, which `drybag docs trail` rewrites; specs live under `docs/specs/` and plans under
`docs/plans/`.
<!-- drybag:harness:end -->
